description: This file contains RBUS handler functions for WAN interface parameters, including get/set handlers for ULONG and string types, event subscription handlers, and row management functions for a WAN interface table.

methods.name: WTC_TableUlongGetHandler
methods.description: Handles getting ULONG parameters from WAN interface table based on property name.

methods.name: WTC_TableUlongSetHandler
methods.description: Handles setting ULONG parameters in WAN interface table based on property name.

methods.name: WTC_TableUlongEventSubHandler
methods.description: Handles event subscription for ULONG parameters in WAN interface table.

methods.name: WTC_TableStringGetHandler
methods.description: Handles getting string parameters from WAN interface table based on property name.

methods.name: WTC_TableStringSetHandler
methods.description: Handles setting string parameters in WAN interface table based on property name.

methods.name: WTC_TableStringEventSubHandler
methods.description: Handles event subscription for string parameters in WAN interface table.

methods.name: WTC_TableAddRowHandler
methods.description: Handles adding a new row to the WAN interface table.

methods.name: WTC_TableRemoveRowHandler
methods.description: Handles removing a row from the WAN interface table.
